changes: Package renamed from rsl_rl to him_rsl_rl to coexist with the container RSL-RL.
Preserve scalar std checkpoint parameter and enforce a positive 0.001 minimum for Gaussian sampling and after PPO optimizer updates.
Correct timeout bootstrap to use pre-reset next critic value; explicit terminated flag takes precedence over timeout.
Reject non-finite estimator/PPO losses and gradients; log estimator and swap losses averaged over minibatches.
Periodic checkpoints now record completed iteration and filename consistently; restore adaptive optimizer learning rates and cumulative counters.
Load own tensor checkpoints with explicit device mapping and weights_only=True for PyTorch 2.11.
Add CPU regression tests for observation target semantics, bootstrap, scalar std validity, mean losses, and checkpoint resume.
Preserve bootstrap math while evaluating only true-timeout rows; batch completed episode statistics into one CPU copy per rollout, preserving tick/id order and the last-100 episode log window.

Add read-only PPO diagnostics to last_update_diagnostics and TensorBoard: mean KL, maximum minibatch mean KL, clip fraction, final std range, final learning rate, and min/max/mean of actual minibatch optimizer learning rates. Preserve four-loss update return, optimizer order, adaptive thresholds and bounds; CPU controls verify identical parameters, Adam state, RNG consumption and losses.
